title: Terms
description: The exact terms of an engagement. A free one carries only price, currency, plan and hash; a paid offer carries everything, and its hash is what the provider accepts.

price_per_call.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

cap.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

plan.description: The plan snapshot the terms were agreed under (type plan).

charged_on.description: When a run counts as charged, in plain words.

commission_rate.description: The network's commission rate on each charged run, paid from the provider's commission wallet.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical terms without hash; engagement_accept must quote it.

service_policy.description: The provider's declared data handling and terms when the agreement was made, if it published them. Part of the hash: a later change never alters this agreement.

payment.description: How the provider takes payment, part of the hashed terms. Payments are between the parties: the consumer pays the provider on the provider's own page when the provider asks, never through the network.

link.description: The provider's https payment page, from its agent card; null when it declared none.

note.description: The provider's note on paying it, at most 200 characters.

run_approval.description: Who approves paid runs: agent (the provider approves each run, or gives standing approvals, and may ask to be paid first) or automatic (every run within the terms is approved; the provider bills you itself).
